headline: Iran War Escalation Creates Dual Energy and Critical Material Crises, Threatening Global Tech Supply Chains
summary: Escalating conflict in the Persian Gulf has resulted in the destruction of 17% of Qatar's LNG capacity for up to five years, while simultaneously triggering a severe global helium shortage. This directly jeopardizes the stability of energy markets, disrupts semiconductor manufacturing, and poses significant risks to AI infrastructure development and broader supply chain logistics.
